title: Create orgos/agile package structure
body:
Create the directory `orgos/agile/` with an empty `__init__.py` file. This provides the module skeleton for subsequent feature stories. No tests needed — pure architecture.

**Done when:** `orgos/agile/__init__.py` exists and Python can import `orgos.agile` without error.

votes.justification: Creating a directory with an empty __init__.py is a trivial mechanical task with no coding risk or unknowns. It requires under 30 minutes and has no dependencies, so 1 point is appropriate.

This is a trivial structural change with zero testing risk – no logic to validate, only a file existence check and import test. From Test's perspective, the only verification needed is a single `python -c "import orgos.agile"` command.
Creating a directory and an empty __init__.py file involves no code logic, no secrets, and no security risk — it's a pure structural change. This task is trivial and well under 30 minutes.

comments.author: test_reviewer
comments.body: Review PASS: Commit f436009 creates orgos/agile/__init__.py with a docstring. File exists and Python imports orgos.agile without error. No test files touched. All acceptance criteria met.
